name: The Missing Chip
description: Two paired stones and a separated chip ask whether one missing case changes the verdict.
method: Native image generation edited the inherited wall. The local finishing helper retained only the bounded new patch and preserved the original pixels outside it.

visual_review.digit_check: Both inherited Pepes have concealed hands; no visible fingers or handprints to count. No new hands.
visual_review.earth_pigments: Charcoal counting stones, red ochre support stroke and one chalk chip on warm bare rock.

limitations: Local visual review is not independent artistic approval.
Rock pixels inside the small added patch may differ. All pixels outside it are identical.
The expressly required numbered JPEG is beside its JSON in dist; no other new image is saved outside artifacts.
